name: Nova Empire Public Company Limited
summary: Nova Empire Public Company Limited manufactures and distributes galvanized iron sheets primarily in Thailand. The company offers hot dipped zinc coated steel sheets, including flat sheets for use in advertising and sign boards, air-ducts, bathroom doors, cabinets, vehicles extensions, and water storage industries; and corrugated sheets for roofing, fencing, partitioning, and siding of houses and buildings, as well as painted hot dipped zinc coated steel flat and corrugated sheets. It also provides roofing and siding installation services. The company was formerly known as Thailand Iron Works Public Company Limited and changed its name to Nova Empire Public Company Limited in February 2021. Nova Empire Public Company Limited was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Phra Samut Chedi, Thailand.
